title: UI Layout Specification
description: Layout specification defining shared header, footer, and structural elements for a layout template

layout.description: Layout identifier matching the layout enum in page specs

description.description: Brief description of when to use this layout

header.description: Header elements shown at the top of all pages using this layout

footer.description: Footer elements shown at the bottom of all pages using this layout

sidebar.description: Sidebar elements for layouts that include a sidebar

wrapper.description: Container configuration for the main content area

maxWidth.description: Maximum width constraint for main content

centered.description: Whether main content should be horizontally centered
